Invalidation rule Threshold Action Why · mechanism

Pre-mortem (written before entry): the most likely failure mode is the earnings event in T-6 — historically VCP setups going into ER show 38% downside surprise probability when IV-rank > 60. The mitigation is mechanical: cap initial size at 50% of normal, exit T2 portion by EOD T-1, accept that the runner sees binary risk. If this trade loses, that's the path it loses on.
What "I'm wrong" looks like: close below $142.95 in the next 5 sessions, or post-ER price reaction < −3%. Either invalidates the FRESH-entry premise and the bullish thesis. Do not anchor; do not average down; mechanical exit.
